title: LifegamesCopyAccessibility
description: Rich authoring schema for the a11y (accessibility) slice of @j0nathan-ll0yd/copy. Every customer-facing accessibility string — aria-labels, image alt text, dialog labels, and pagination/region labels — is a CopyString leaf carrying authoring context in _meta. The two identity-slice a11y strings (skipToMain, ogImageAlt) intentionally remain in the identity namespace and are NOT duplicated here. The copy build derives a FLAT schema from this one (stripping _meta) for all consumer codegen (TS/Zod/Swift). Strings are authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax; interpolated templates are substituted at the call site (no MessageFormat runtime). Casing is natural case: a11y copy needs no display uppercasing transform. The $defs block is byte-identical to schema/identity.schema.json and schema/widgets.schema.json; the $defs are inlined per schema file (no cross-file $ref), which the flat-schema derivation requires.

CopyMeta.description: Authoring context attached to every copy leaf (D6). Drives auditing, reconciliation, and CI-lintable constraints.

description.description: What this string is and why it exists.

usage.description: Every render site / placement where this string appears (file:line or surface name). Makes duplication and placement visible for reconciliation (D11).

register.description: Voice register (see packages/copy/VOICE.md): atom | label | factual | expressive | machine | brand | consent.

audience.description: Primary audience: human | machine | dual. Drives the human↔AI arbitration rule (machine/dual surfaces stay literal/parseable).

lastReviewed.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the wording was last deliberately reviewed.

maxChars.description: Maximum rendered length. CI fails if value exceeds this.

rationale.description: Optional: why this wording/variant exists distinctly (intent, history).

CopyString.description: A single customer-facing string (ICU MF1 syntax) plus its authoring context.

value.description: The string, authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax.

CopyStringList.description: An ordered list of customer-facing strings (each ICU MF1) plus shared authoring context.

value.description: The strings, each authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax.

CopyHeading.description: A section heading, authored as the BARE heading text plus its authoring context. The markdown level affix ('# ', '## ') is a projection owned by the consumer's renderer, not part of the copy — a leaf that ships one is un-rendered again by any consumer that models document structure (atlas decision 0128 P3a). The 'pattern' rejects a leaf that still carries the affix. Flattens to a plain string, so the consumer-facing type is the same as CopyString.

value.description: The heading text, authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax. Carries no leading markdown '#' affix and no leading whitespace.

CopyLink.description: A link, authored as FIELDS plus its authoring context. The rendered markdown bullet ('- [label](url): notes') is a projection owned by the consumer's renderer, not part of the copy — a leaf that ships one is regex-parsed back into these same three fields by the consumer (atlas decision 0128 P3a). Each 'pattern' rejects a field that still carries an affix. Flattens to an object, hoisted into the derived flat schema's own $defs so every generator names ONE shared type instead of one structural copy per key.

value.description: The link's fields. 'label' and 'notes' are authored prose; 'url' is the target.

label.description: The link's visible text, authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax. Carries no list-bullet affix and no markdown link brackets.

url.description: The link target, authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax — a {placeholder} base the consumer substitutes, plus any literal path. Carries no surrounding markdown parentheses and no whitespace.

notes.description: Optional prose describing the target. Carries no leading ': ' separator.
